demonstrated_use: Select the exact parser and reject incompatible table rows.
Join each row to run provenance, one replicon, or one immutable source record without repeating metadata.
Resolve a public query and reacquire the exact accession version.
Route chromosome/plasmid and topology controls, validate coordinates, and verify recovered sequence bytes.
Bind every table to the exact parameter and frozen-source contracts.
Keep canonical-producer provenance as one typed run-level structure.
Prove that Sounio at the bound source/compiler/executable produced the logical artifact.
Prevent generated or excluded rows from being promoted to validated observations.
Audit run duration and temporal source/release ordering.
Locate one zero-based half-open interval for query and independent recomputation.
Project the declared R/RC operator panel without unrelated legacy columns.
Select the operator and k stratum for calibration lookup and summaries.
Expose the number of eligible positions after ambiguity masking and validate exact denominators.
Represent the observed operator value as one exact fraction or an explicit unavailable value.
Recompute the exact observed value without relying on rounded floating point.
Retrieve the ready dinucleotide-null calibration instead of repeating 1000 draws.
Prove that exactly 1000 eligible null draws completed or that none are claimed.
Support robust display and comparison to the precomputed null distribution.
Validate every stored null statistic exactly without a rounded duplicate.
Compare observed and null values while exposing the complete 1000-draw order partition without p-values.
Explain every unavailable metric, null, interval, or record without silent row loss.
Check that replicon summaries account for every candidate window.
Distinguish a whole-record exclusion from a window or metric-specific exclusion.
